assumptions: finArea_m2=0.015: wing loading ~49 N/m2, plausible for exocoetids; my choice.
CLmax=1.2: typical for a fixed, unflapped fin; my choice.
LD_max=10: modest glide ratio; my choice.
airspeed_m_s=12: above stall speed (~8.2 m/s from W=0.736 N, S, CLmax), giving CL~0.56 < CLmax.
glideDistance_m=9.5: kept below LD_max*glideHeight (10 m) as an unpowered glide cannot exceed it.
powered=false added alongside flight_mode=glide to be explicit.
wind_along_track_m_s=0 (still air), ground_distance_m=9.5 equals glideDistance, flight_duration_s=0.79 = 9.5/12; added to widen the set of evaluable laws.
notes: No law appears to block the brief. Aerobic-demand laws C14 and E3 are out of scope because the flight is an unpowered glide, so they are not evaluated. Physiology keys (swimbladder, thermal, energy budget) are left out because they don't apply to a glide. That means those laws will probably return cannot-evaluate. I could not run lean_check, so none of this is verified. The numbers are checked by hand against basic glide physics: lift equals weight at the chosen speed, stall speed is below airspeed, and distance is at most L/D times height.
